chunks.title: How to Setup Stripe Payment Gateway
chunks.category: Finance > Payment Gateways
chunks.text:
Article: How to Setup Stripe Payment Gateway
Category: Finance > Payment Gateways
Section: Overview of Stripe Integration

Brilliant Directories includes direct API integration with Stripe for processing recurring membership subscriptions, one-time payments, and digital product sales. Stripe supports credit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and SEPA direct debit.

chunks.title: How to Setup Stripe Payment Gateway
chunks.category: Finance > Payment Gateways
chunks.text:
Article: How to Setup Stripe Payment Gateway
Category: Finance > Payment Gateways
Section: Step-by-Step Stripe Configuration

To connect your Stripe account:
1. Navigate to Finance > Payment Gateways in your admin dashboard.
2. In the 'Active Payment Gateway' dropdown, select 'Stripe'.
3. Click on the 'Credentials' tab.
4. Paste your Stripe Publishable Key (pk_live_...) and Stripe Secret Key (sk_live_...).
5. Configure the Webhook Endpoint URL in your Stripe Dashboard to point to your website webhook URL.
6. Click the blue 'Save Changes' button in the upper right.

chunks.title: How to Process Member Refunds and Account Cancellations
chunks.category: Finance > Transaction History
chunks.text:
Article: How to Process Member Refunds and Account Cancellations
Category: Finance > Transaction History
Section: Refunding a Member Transaction

To issue a full or partial refund to a member:
1. Navigate to Finance > Transaction History in your admin menu.
2. Locate the specific invoice or transaction using member name or invoice ID.
3. Click the 'Action' dropdown on the right side of the transaction row.
4. Select 'Issue Refund'.
5. Specify whether you are issuing a Full Refund or Partial Refund (enter the refund dollar amount).
6. Check the box if you want to notify the member by email.
7. Click the red 'Confirm Refund' button. The refund is automatically transmitted to Stripe or PayPal.

chunks.title: Connecting a Custom Domain Name and Free SSL Certificate
chunks.category: Settings > Domain Settings
chunks.text:
Article: Connecting a Custom Domain Name and Free SSL Certificate
Category: Settings > Domain Settings
Section: Connecting Your Live Domain

To connect your custom domain (e.g. www.yourdomain.com):
1. Log into your domain registrar (GoDaddy, Namecheap, Cloudflare, Google Domains).
2. Create an A Record pointing to the Brilliant Directories server IP address.
3. In your Brilliant Directories admin, navigate to Settings > Domain Manager.
4. Click 'Add Custom Domain', enter your domain name, and click 'Connect Domain'.

chunks.title: Connecting a Custom Domain Name and Free SSL Certificate
chunks.category: Settings > Domain Settings
chunks.text:
Article: Connecting a Custom Domain Name and Free SSL Certificate
Category: Settings > Domain Settings
Section: Enabling Free SSL (HTTPS)

Brilliant Directories automatically provisions a free Let's Encrypt SSL security certificate once your DNS A-records have propagated. Under Settings > Domain Manager, click 'Install Free SSL' and toggle 'Force HTTPS Everywhere' to green.

chunks.title: Connecting a Custom Domain Name and Free SSL Certificate
chunks.category: Settings > Domain Settings
chunks.text:
Article: Connecting a Custom Domain Name and Free SSL Certificate

2. Go to Settings > Domain Manager in admin dashboard
3. Click Add Custom Domain
4. Enter domain name and click Connect Domain

chunks.title: Configuring PayPal Standard vs PayPal Commerce Platform Gateway
chunks.category: Finance > Payment Gateways
chunks.text:
Article: Configuring PayPal Standard vs PayPal Commerce Platform Gateway
Category: Finance > Payment Gateways
Section: PayPal Integration Options

Brilliant Directories supports both PayPal Standard and the modern PayPal Commerce Platform.
- PayPal Commerce Platform provides an embedded on-site checkout experience supporting credit cards and PayPal Smart Buttons without redirecting away from your directory.
- PayPal Standard redirects the user off-site to PayPal.com to complete payment.
To configure:
1. Go to Finance > Payment Gateways.
2. Select 'PayPal Commerce Platform' or 'PayPal Standard'.
3. Enter your PayPal Client ID, Secret, and Merchant ID.
4. Click 'Save Changes'.

chunks.title: Can I Send A Mass Email Campaign Using Brilliant Directories?
chunks.category: Solution home > Section: Emails > Email FAQ > Can I Send A Mass Email Campaign Using Brilliant Directories?
chunks.section_heading: Can I Send A Mass Email Campaign Using Brilliant Directories?
chunks.text:
Article: Can I Send A Mass Email Campaign Using Brilliant Directories?
Category: Solution home > Section: Emails > Email FAQ > Can I Send A Mass Email Campaign Using Brilliant Directories?
Section: Can I Send A Mass Email Campaign Using Brilliant Directories?

Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000558357
The built-in email system is designed for emailing active members who have requested to receive emails from the site. A common example would be sending a monthly newsletter to members who have opted in to receive updates.
The email system also sends transactional emails, such as new member signup notifications, credit card update notices, lead emails, and other system-generated messages related to member activity.
Sending mass unsolicited emails to Claim Listings or an imported contact list may be considered spam. This can violate email compliance laws, damage the sending reputation of your domain, and result in future emails being blocked or blacklisted.
In some cases, sending spam messages can also negatively impact other sites on the same server and may lead to account restrictions or termination with Brilliant Directories.

Section: Create and manage mailboxes

On the Mailboxes tab, Add a mailbox creates a new mailbox with its password and storage limit. Each mailbox in the list offers Open webmail , Set up for the settings to enter in Outlook, Apple Mail, or a phone, and More for changing the password or storage limit or deleting the mailbox. The full steps are in Settings » Domain Manager » Mailboxes and Email Routing .
Generic addresses such as info@ are more often treated as spam by receiving mail systems. Addresses such as support@ , admin@ , or contact@ are usually a better choice.

chunks.text:
Article: Email Forwarders
Category: Solution home > Section: Emails > Email Accounts > Email Forwarders
Section: Email Forwarders Not Supported

IMPORTANT: The Email Forwarders functionality has been removed from our implementation of cPanel as of June, 2024.
Due to the way this functionality works in cPanel, it caused several issues for users. Some of these issue included:
Not all emails being forwarded properly based on the domain settings of the email sender and the receiver of the forwarded email Sendgrid blocking emails from being sent to accounts hosted in cPanel, preventing the Admins of sites from getting notification emails The domain reputation and reputation of the server being harmed when SPAM emails are forwarded through this system
While email forwarders can no longer be added or modified, any existing email forwarders will remain in place.  If an email forwarder needs to be removed from a site, please submit a ticket to our Support Team for assistance.

Section: Step 1: Create The Category Structure in a CSV file

Download the Category Structure Import Template (attached at the bottom of the article). Open up the file and expand the width of the columns so all of the text can be seen in each one. Column A will have all of the Top-Level Categories Column B will have all of the Sub Categories (optional) Column C will have all of the Sub-Sub Categories (optional)
4. Fill out the spreadsheet with the categories by replacing the placeholders in the template.

Article: How To Import Categories Via CSV File

Section: Step 2: Import The Category Structure

Navigate to Members >> Member Categories select Import Categories:
The button will lead to a new page where it is possible to import the file:
CRITICAL WARNING: Checking the option to delete existing categories will permanently remove all current categories from the database. This action will also unassign all current members from their categories, requiring them to be manually recategorized or re-imported. Only check this box if starting a completely brand-new directory or performing a total category reset. Upload the file here.
Find the Category Import template attached to this article.
IMPORTANT NOTE: By default, all members can be listed in 1 Top Level / Main Category and multiple Sub Categories. However, there is a workaround : Workaround: Members Selecting Multiple Top-Level Categories
